summary: Nine-metre kerb in front of houses, shorter than a van.

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes front the kerb at 9 m and 14 m; carport 6 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is under a van length and runs between driveways.
drivers.traffic: Through road, tree-shaded, with parking on both sides.
drivers.convention: 2P parallel parking signs; cars park here but only briefly.

flags: Dwelling within 10 m rules it out
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the road and verge.
